scenarios.name: APPT-CONFIRMATION — hardcoded location phrase fires on first turn
scenarios.expected_behavior: APPOINTMENT CONFIRMATION fires. Spoken output must contain 'at Farrell Street Family Practice in Yandina' — NOT '{{business_name}}' or any other placeholder. Then ask 'What's your full name for the booking?' PASS only if both the hardcoded location phrase AND the name question appear.

scenarios.name: PHONE-COLLECTION — no caller_id, after name collected asks for phone

history.content: Perfect, 2 PM Thursday the 7th with Tetyana at Farrell Street Family Practice in Yandina. What's your full name for the booking?

scenarios.expected_behavior: phone_needs_collection=true (no caller_id). After name 'Jane Smith' confirmed (it's clear/unambiguous → silent store, no readback), step 1.5 PHONE fires. Speak exactly: 'And what's a good number to reach you on?' No tool call.

scenarios.name: SIGNAL4-FIRES — all DVs set + caller_id captured
scenarios.expected_behavior: Signal 4 fires: phone_needs_collection=false (caller_id captured), all 3 name/email DVs non-empty. Speak 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND call smart_voice_agent intent='book'. FAIL if spoken text is missing OR tool call is missing OR a different tool is called.
